upstream.note: agent-computer/src not in sparse checkout; direct computer API is intentionally NOT the runtime path. Runtime must go via server gateway /api/computers. Missing supervisor helper files (names/authorisation/environment) fetched pinned 2026-11-03 via raw.githubusercontent for exact validation rules and included here.

auth.derivation: exact upstream supervisor/src/authorisation.ts authorised(): timingSafeEqual(Buffer('Bearer '+token), header); NOT HMAC, NOT derived, NOT hashed. Token from env SUPERVISOR_TOKEN, required or supervisor refuses to start.

body.carryOver: optional list of <=20 legacy bot ids

verbs_only.conflict: 409 NameHeldError when derived name held by non-owned container
verbs_only.bad_id: 400 id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$, len 1..64, kind person|bot

verbs_only.body: same, carryOver forbidden (400 Only a person's computer inherits a Bot's profile)

identity_mapping.rule: path id is the UPSTREAM person id, validated by supervisor/src/names.ts namesFor(): ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$, max 64, derived container {namespace}-computer-{kind}-{id}, volumes {namespace}-profile-{kind}-{id} and {namespace}-workspace-{kind}-{id}, labels openbot.supervisor/namespace/person-id|bot-id/kind. Caller NEVER sends container name.
identity_mapping.me_to_upstream: Me users.id -> 1:1 upstream BetterAuth users.id via SERVER-SIDE exchange only. Client-supplied user_id/workspace/model rejected. No shared dev-local-user, no OPENBOT_SINGLE_USER=true on shared/home (see auth). Upstream person id SHOULD be the mapped upstream user id (stable per family member). Home validates ht1_* session first, then selects its own per-user computer.
identity_mapping.namespace: COMPUTER_NAMESPACE default 'openbot', same ALLOWED rules; isolates two stacks on one Docker host

supervisor.network: Compose publishes supervisor 127.0.0.1:${SUPERVISOR_PORT:-4500}->4300; server inside compose reaches supervisor:4300 with COMPUTER_NETWORK set (no published port). Computer ports published 127.0.0.1:${COMPUTER_PORT:-4100}->4100 loopback only.
source_refs: supervisor/src/index.ts (4 verbs, Bearer check, carryOverOf <=20, 409/503 mapping)
supervisor/src/environment.ts (COMPUTER_TOKEN, COMPUTER_BROWSER_MODE headed|headless, EGRESS_PROXY* passthrough, COMPUTER_SEPARATE_WORKSPACES=on)

computer_transport_direct_NOT_RUNTIME_PA.warning: Runtime client MUST NOT call agent-computer:4100 directly. Policy/audit/identity live in server gateway. Direct transport documented only so B does not reinvent it.
computer_transport_direct_NOT_RUNTIME_PA.base: located supervisor url or AGENT_COMPUTER_URL single-container dev

auth_headers.x-openbot-computer-token: <COMPUTER_TOKEN> exact, required, permits only GET /health without it

computer_transport_direct_NOT_RUNTIME_PA.derivation: exact upstream server/src/computer/client.ts createComputerTransport + provider.ts sharedSeatHeaders/seatHeaders: headers as above, NOT Authorization Bearer. Timeout 45s default, exec up to 600s. Source: client.ts seatHeaders(), provider.ts headers().

server_gateway_RUNTIME_PATH.mount: server/src/app.ts: app.route('/api/computers', createComputerRoutes(...)) behind session guard + bot-access (computerAccessCheck/canUseBot). Requires upstream session for mapped user; admin routes require admin.
server_gateway_RUNTIME_PATH.auth: Upstream BetterAuth session (Google/Microsoft-Entra/Okta + INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAILS + BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/URL + TRUSTED_ORIGINS). PROHIBITED: OPENBOT_SINGLE_USER=true on any shared/home deployment (every visitor becomes admin dev@openbot.local dev-local-user, server/src/auth/dev-actor.ts). No client user_id override.

routes.ok: 200 ScreenshotResult {base64,width,height,capturedAt,url?} or {ready:false,state,reason?} when not ready; checked against navigation page (frameIsOfThisPage)

routes.note: response carries characters count, NEVER echoed text

routes.ok: 200 state (bot asks for value it must not be told)

routes.note: ONLY place secret value enters; never logged, audit records count only

routes.kinds: click|type|key|scroll (human mouse/keyboard, NOT policy-decided, takeover is audited event; shapes checked per kind)

routes.ok: 200 {frame|null} candidates: own seat, personSeat, botId legacy

routes.fail_closed: malformed => 400, server refuses to start with bad policy

error_mapping.400: malformed (incl. bad ref shape, timeoutMs range, unknown kind)
error_mapping.409: stale:true (snapshot superseded, take fresh), humanHasControl:true (stop, leave to holder), needsConversation:true (resend via approval route), controlRequestError:true
error_mapping.503: ComputerUnavailableError + starting:true,notPerformed:true when cold start (retry, not outage)

source_refs: server/src/computer/routes.ts (all routes above, seatOf, act(), errorBody/statusFor)
server/src/computer/gateway.ts (govern(): resolve ref from server snapshot -> evaluateActionPolicy -> audit row -> act; sessionOf generation check)

approval_snapshot_control.snapshot_version: integer snapshotId handed by POST snapshot; every acting call must send {ref,snapshotId}; gateway loads server-held snapshot (DB-backed in prod, in-memory in unit) and resolves ref ONLY if stored.snapshotId==input.snapshotId AND generation(sessionOf)==stored run; else 409 stale:true (+snapshotRequired). Refs opaque, never constructed.
approval_snapshot_control.fingerprint: thread ids carry DEPLOYMENT_ID fingerprint (UUIDv8, 6-byte digest); owns(threadId) checks deployment; computer session fingerprints runs (container start/ready moment). Refs never cross seat: filed under seatText() person:<id>/<bot> or bot:<bot>. Never cross-user.
approval_snapshot_control.control: ComputerControlState holder bot|human; request(take turns waiting->taken), release/cancel, secret request/supply split; humanInput bypasses policy but takeover is audited; browserCleared clears snapshots+frames. See shared/computer-control.ts types.

browser_workspace_isolation.per_person: COMPUTER_SUPERVISOR_URL set: each person gets container of own; every Bot they use has own folder in /workspace + own Chromium profile in /profiles; isolated Bot gets own container. Shell reaches container network (data net Postgres NOT on same net; egress filter proxy applies, cloud metadata refused always). COMPUTER_SEPARATE_WORKSPACES=on.
browser_workspace_isolation.shared_fallback: AGENT_COMPUTER_URL only: one container for everybody; seats keep own profile+folder but shell can read any path in container. Admin screen warns. Me CORE default MUST be per-person when supervisor configured; never silently claim identical.
browser_workspace_isolation.egress: browser+shell via filter proxy; EGRESS_PROXY_<BOT>|DEFAULT attribution (not boundary); EGRESS_POLICY_REQUIRED=1 default; raw sockets not stopped (needs K8s NetworkPolicy). COMPUTER_SHELL_ENV allowlist only; PATH/locale/proxy inherited, secrets not.

do_not_track.override: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or COPILOTKIT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 always overrides OPENBOT_PRODUCT_TELEMETRY=1. No prompts/answers/URLs/names/credentials exported (docs/.env.example).
do_not_track.me_rule: Home never enables upstream product telemetry by default; explicit operator opt-in only.

copilotkit_rpc_WARNING.do_not_invent: Do NOT call POST /api/copilotkit with raw AG-UI RunAgentInput {threadId,runId,agentId,messages} from runtime. /api/copilotkit is CopilotKit Hono handler (createCopilotHonoHandler basePath /api/copilotkit, server/src/copilot.ts mountCopilotRuntime mode:'intelligence'), gateway-JOIN semantics: returns {threadId,runId,joinToken,realtime} then streams; completion/reply only via gateway events. toolkit/src/run-turn.ts mirrors private runCanonicalChannelAgent + 5 x- methods; NOT a public raw AG-UI endpoint.
copilotkit_rpc_WARNING.audited_shape: Internal RunAgentInput restated in toolkit/src/ports.ts + run-turn.ts TurnRunner; agent-langgraph-agui /health contract is harness-only. Full server facade (if ever needed) must audit exact published RPC shape from @copilotkit/runtime 1.69.0 dist/v2 + copilot.ts, not guess. CORE computer use does NOT need CopilotKit facade.
copilotkit_rpc_WARNING.exchange_WARNING: Me ht1_* (SHA-256 stored, sessions JOIN devices) -> BetterAuth identity EXCHANGE IS NOT an existing upstream feature. No source extension verifies it. Must be built server-side (home validates ht1, asserts mapped upstream user via provider sign-in or OPENBOT_ORGANIZATION_AUTH_URL employee authority). NEVER fake user headers/shared admin. See server/src/copilot.ts IdentifyUser/IdentifyActor injection + server/src/auth/*.

core_scope_for_B.allowed: ONLY home-validated owner selects private computer (person:<mappedUpstreamId>); home holds SUPERVISOR_TOKEN + COMPUTER_TOKEN server-side (0600/private host); per-computer credential NEVER to LLM/phone; no runtime public actor override; no fallback to custom browser/runner if upstream unavailable (return NEEDS_SETUP/unavailable, fail closed).
core_scope_for_B.model_privacy: Local Ollama default; explicitly opted-in remote receives scoped prompt/history/tool context only. No managed cloud conversation storage under home privacy default.
core_scope_for_B.agent_bot_auth: MANAGED_AGENT_AG_UI_URL + MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN paired (x-openbot-agent-token); AGENT_TOOL_TOKEN for tool callbacks; WORKER_SHARED_SECRET for routine handoff. AGENT_ENDPOINT_ALLOWED_HOSTS exact host allowlist; never AGENT_COMPUTER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS in production.
